Hannover Re has for a second time increased the target size of what will be the seventh catastrophe bond offering in the annual Acorn Re parametric US earthquake series of deals, now seeking $450 million of limit from the Acorn Re Ltd. Mexico gets its first World Bank Cat DDO, to complement cat bonds and parametric insurance

The Government of Mexico has received its first World Bank Catastrophe Deferred Drawdown Option (Cat DDO), which will help the country prepare better and respond more quickly to natural disasters, while also complementing both of its IBRD CAR Mexico 2024 and IBRD CAR Mexico 2024 (Pacific) catastrophe bonds and parametric insurance protection. The World Bank Group has approved US $500 million in financing, marking the first time Mexico has accessed a Catastrophe Deferred Drawdown Option (Cat DDO). We are proud to support the Government of Mexico in this first Cat DDO,” commented Juan Pablo Uribe, World Bank Director for Mexico, Central America, and the Dominican Republic.

  1. El dato clave: The World Bank Group has approved US $500 million in financing, marking the first time Mexico has accessed a Catastrophe Deferred Drawdown Option (Cat DDO).

Dutch insurance distributor and financial products advisor RISK Ventures has acquired a majority stake in Vergelijkdirect.com, a Soest-based platform for comparing and purchasing personal and business insurance. Funding from rounds of at least $100 million fell 43.3%, from $9.07 billion in Q2 to $5.15 billion in Q3, accounting for approximately 93% of the overall dollar decline.
